related.title: NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器
related.why: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.whyEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.transfer: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.transferEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.difference: 本課針對開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面；NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器改以雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces; NVIDIA DGX H100 eight-GPU server centers on dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照sled與主機拓撲與H100與主記憶拓撲，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NVIDIA DGX H100 八 GPU 伺服器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以維護邊界與隔離為起點，設計一項能區分「開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面」與「雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare sled/host topology with h100 and host-memory topology and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NVIDIA DGX H100 eight-GPU server, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from maintenance boundaries and isolation and propose an observation distinguishing open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces from dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器
history.text: OCP Yosemite V3 模組伺服器的公開資料展示開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for OCP Yosemite V3 modular server illustrate open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將開放模組、共用服務與硬體介面改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns open modules, shared services and hardware interfaces into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
